review: Fresh visual and crop review of the integrated artwork and supplied desktop/mobile screenshots.
desktop: The 500×570 hero reads as a woven web, with several bright, broad paths distinct from the fine filaments. It remains legible at the screenshot scale, though the many hairlines make the crossings visually busy. The composition feels sculptural and atmospheric rather than like a proof diagram.
mobile: The supplied mobile-top screenshot shows only the beginning of the artwork card at the bottom edge. It cannot establish whether the full 350×320 crop preserves the web and strand separation; review of that full crop remains open.
brandFit: Strong palette fit: charcoal ground, warm ivory, muted antique gold, and a small star motif echo Moriarty’s banner. The artwork replaces the portrait without introducing people, text, neon, or generic globe imagery.
materialIssue: No blocking desktop issue observed. Mobile crop legibility is unverified because the screenshot cuts off most of the artwork.
